title: Original parsable XML node data and cached-child state
oracle: Independent literal node/attribute/content records, explicit decimal-prefix/range expectations and BigInt big-endian byte arithmetic supply expected values. Real constructor-created child wrappers and their returned arrays provide natural retained-reference/membership observations. Original source XmlParsingFailure reasons and nonstring attribute errors supply selected failure expectations; no source output is used as its own golden or helper implementation.

trials.execution: Configured fresh-process diagnostics passed 31 tests: 30 cases and 30 unchanged comparisons retained 60 content-addressed records containing 90 single-revision executions and1296 probe executions across both source pins. These local observations are partial source implementation evidence, with isolated:false; no clean committed-suite primary receipts or old-family requalification are claimed here.
trials.recognizedGateAssignmentScope: The complete supported-static eight-module closure recognizes zero gates; an empty-gate context is the sole modeled assignment, not semantic/environment/input or complete XML validation proof.
trials.attributeScope: Selected empty/Unicode/combining/emoji/markup-like and1025-character raw strings; hasAttr uses own-property membership and missing/nonstring reads differ. No XML escaping/namespace/entity/text parser or all-string-domain claim.
trials.integerScope: Selected parseInt(text,10) decimal-prefix behavior, malformed strings and inclusive lower/exclusive upper checks; values such as17tail,5.9,1e3,0x10 characterize prefix parsing rather than strict integer grammar. No general safe-integer, precision, all bound/coercion or numeric-domain proof.
trials.enumScope: Plain JSON mapping records and array/set enum values only, including selected0/false/null/fallbackfalse/empty returns. No enum callback/function input, inherited property traversal or reflective selector.
trials.contentScope: Nullish/falsy/raw content presence and public unsafeSetNodeContent histories are characterized. contentString/contentBytes are not general type validators; selected false/0/empty raw values retain their source behavior.

binaryContent.scope: Actual typed bytes with independently computed big-endian integer values within the selected safe range; one length-error/recovery pair per size. No arbitrary byte-width/precision/ownership or content-type completeness claim.

cachedChildren.initialization: Constructor eagerly wraps initial array content in actual ParsableXmlNode child instances; getChildren returns that cached array.
cachedChildren.transitions: Mutating an actual child through its public method changes its content. Replacing raw node content does not rebuild cached wrappers; clearing cached children exposes raw content, restoring the actual retained child array restores original child identities. Empty[] replacement is a genuine empty collection, not fake child wrappers.
cachedChildren.identityScope: Seven source-return retains, nine identity projections and seven actual array.includes projections across the planned cases. First child selection, stale cache and restoration use genuine source instances/arrays. No input retention, private-field access, mutation/ownership proof beyond explicit public methods or fabricated parser objects.
cachedChildren.duplicateTagDiscriminator: The selected duplicate-a child fixture has idfirst/idsecond values; child(a) followed by the real returned child attrString(id) expects literal first. Tag equality/repeat identity/membership alone are not used as proof of first-vs-later duplicate selection.

trials.errorScope: WAXmlParsingFailure exports a real plain class carrying parser/reason and a source toString formatter; it is not an Error subclass and needs no Babel helper. Expected name Error is the worker fallback projection label, with the literal XmlParsingFailure formatter message; nonstring decodeAsString errors use the real err dependency. No fake error class or missing-capability TypeError is accepted as an application failure.
trials.runtimeScope: Focused observations bind runtimeSource201922bde0fa261c2b0117856c1c0a003e90c21f56f053d5437e6075e90c3237 and worker02af79cc54aa2da613c84e48128557c1111635507fa4b1acb0e42024888c0406. trials.fixtures: Case.construct uses the actual exported ParsableXmlNode and synthetic already-parsed node data. No stubs, clock/gate/bootstrap/Babel fixtures, callback/function input, reflection, private-property control or per-suite source wrapper is selected.
